🗓 RARE OPENING — April 22 to May 3

Villa Luisa just opened up for one of the last available windows this season.

This is a beachfront sanctuary on Patzcuaro Beach that rarely sits empty — and for good reason.

🏡 3 bedrooms · 3.5 bathrooms · sleeps up to 8
🌊 Private infinity pool overlooking the Pacific
👨‍🍳 Dedicated private chef — included in your stay
🔥 Outdoor kitchen · BBQ · fire pit
🏖 Direct beach access from your terrace

When you're not at the villa:

🏄 World-class surf breaks at Sayulita & Punta de Mita
🐋 Whale watching tours from La Cruz marina
🤿 Snorkeling & diving at Islas Marietas (Blue Lagoon)
🚤 Deep-sea fishing charters right off the coast
🧘 Yoga and wellness retreats in Sayulita village
🛵 Explore the cobblestone streets of old-town Sayulita
🌮 Rooftop restaurants & mezcal bars 10 minutes away
⛳ Golf at the Punta Mita Four Seasons course (optional add-on)

April 22 – May 3 is the last quiet stretch before high season locks in. After that, availability disappears until fall.
